description: South Asia - MODIS Active Fire Detections is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System. Near-real-time active fire and thermal anomaly detections from NASA's Fire Information for Resource Management System (FIRMS) covering South Asia, derived from the MODIS sensor family (Terra since 2000, Aqua since 2002). Each resource is an external link directly to a NASA-hosted file. Coverage: Afghanistan, Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher NASA Fire Information for Resource Management System. Its tags are climate hazards, environment, geodata, hazards and risk, natural disasters. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
